content: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all products. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, you can return it for a full refund within 30 days of receipt.
To initiate a return, log in to your account, go to 'Order History', select the item you wish to return, and click 'Request Refund'. You will receive a return shipping label via email.
Once we receive your returned item, please allow 5-7 business days for us to process your refund. The funds will be returned to your original payment method.
Standard shipping typically takes 3-5 business days within the continental US. International shipping may take 10-14 business days.
You can track your order status by visiting the 'Track Order' page on our website and entering your order number and email address. Tracking updates are sent via email.
If your package is marked as delivered but you haven't received it, please check with neighbors and your local post office. If it is still missing after 48 hours, contact support.
To reset your password, click on the 'Forgot Password?' link on the login page. Enter your registered email address, and we will send you a link to set a new password.
For security reasons, your account will be locked after 5 failed login attempts. You can unlock it by resetting your password or waiting 30 minutes.
The Laptop X features a high-capacity battery that provides up to 12 hours of mixed usage on a single charge.
The standard model comes with 16GB of DDR4 RAM. It is upgradeable to 32GB.
All our hardware products come with a standard 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Extended warranty plans are available for purchase.
If you receive a damaged or defective item, please contact our support team immediately with photos of the damage. We will arrange for a replacement or a full refund at no extra cost.
Standard shipping is free on orders over $50. For orders under $50, a flat rate of $9.99 applies. Expedited shipping options are calculated at checkout.
For international orders, customs duties and taxes may apply upon arrival in your country. These fees are the responsibility of the recipient.
The Laptop X features a 15.6-inch 4K UHD OLED display with a resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels and 100% sRGB color gamut coverage.
It is powered by the latest Gen AI-9 Processor with 12 cores and 24 threads, reaching boost speeds of up to 5.2 GHz.
Storage options include 512GB, 1TB, or 2TB of ultra-fast NVMe SSD storage.
